title: Verify design precedence with mixed input paths
summary: Exercise both legacy and explicit tenant inputs when consolidating design resolution.
reusable_steps: Exercise both legacy and explicit tenant inputs when consolidating design resolution
expected_outcome: When two design resolvers converge, add a regression fixture with a valid public design system and an existing tenant palette and logo. Run the fixture through the legacy input and again with an explicit tenant slug. Assert that tenant branding remains in scope and that the applied base theme identity can be distinguished from style and tenant overlays.
